/-- The datum extracted from a genus-degree class has genus degree after every field-valued
coefficient extension.

This is forced by the two class-identification fields of `P`; it is not an additional rank-one
hypothesis. -/
theorem classDeg_baseChange
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
    classDeg L
      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C :=
  PicRankOneLocalPresentation.datum_classDeg_baseChange_of_representation
    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class L

/-- Split witnesses for the represented class on every residue field give the exact residue
`H¹` witnesses for the same extracted datum.

The proof first identifies the datum with its relative Picard representative, uses the existing
pointwise presentation equivalence, and then transports across the canonical comparison between
the scheme-theoretic and algebraic residue fields. -/
theorem residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    (hsplit : ∀ t : (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left,
      IsSplitWitness C
        (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
          (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
            (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))))) :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
  intro p
  have hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C pi
      (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
        (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass))
      P.datum :=
    isChartDatumPlusFibre_of_relPicToPicEt C pi
      P.datum.cechPicClass P.datum rfl
  have hpres := isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower C pi hfib
  have hs : IsSplitWitness C
      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint
        (show (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left from p))
        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) P.datum.cechPicClass))) := by
    simpa only [← P.datum_class] using hsplit p
  have hp : P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
    (hpres p).mpr hs
  letI : Algebra p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
    ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of P.cover.Carrier) p).inv).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      (algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors p)
  exact (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension
    p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) p)).mpr hp

end PicRankOneNativeDatum

    11	/-!
    12	# Cover independence for section-cut evaluation divisors
    13	
    14	The evaluation divisor used by the arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`
    15	producer is cut from an actual glued section.  Pulling such a divisor through an affine
    16	coefficient change retains the pulled-back pointed cover, whereas the direct construction
    17	uses the canonical pointed cover of the base-changed cocycle datum.  This file supplies the
    18	pure refinement step between those covers: local equations cut by the same section on any
    19	two subordinated pointed covers are `DivEq`.
    20	
    21	The comparison unit is the datum's transition unit restricted to the common refinement.
    22	Thus this result records construction-level divisor equality, not merely equality of Picard
    23	classes, and assumes neither `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` nor a pullback square.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
    37	
    38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    39	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    40	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k}
    41	
    42	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    43	
    44	/-- Local equations cut by one glued section are independent, up to `DivEq`, of the
    45	subordinated pointed cover used to write them.  The witness is the intersection cover and
    46	the restricted transition unit between the two selected datum pieces. -/
    47	theorem sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section
    48	    [IsAffineHom pi]
    49	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    50	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
    51	    (W W' : (relCurve C B).PointedCover)
    52	    (σ σ' : relCurve C B → D.index)
    53	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x))
    54	    (hσ' : ∀ x : relCurve C B, W'.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x))
    55	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (x : relCurve C B) (hx : x ∈ D.pieces j),
    56	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) x hx).hom (D.component s j)
    57	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk x)) :
    58	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
    59	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W σ hσ hreg)
    60	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s W' σ' hσ' hreg) := by
    61	  refine ⟨W ⊓ W', (fun _ => inf_le_left), (fun _ => inf_le_right), fun x => ?_⟩
    62	  have hleft : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) :=
    63	    inf_le_left.trans (hσ x)
    64	  have hright : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
    65	    inf_le_right.trans (hσ' x)
    66	  have hoverlap : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
    67	    le_inf hleft hright
    68	  have htriple : (W ⊓ W').opens x ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x) :=
    69	    le_inf (le_inf le_top hleft) hright
    70	  refine ⟨(relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)), ?_⟩
    71	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom htriple)
    72	    (s.property (σ x) (σ' x))
    73	  rw [map_mul] at key
    74	  simp only [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
    75	  change (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_left
    76	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component s (σ x))) =
    77	    ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
    78	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) *
    79	      (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right
    80	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ' x) (D.component s (σ' x)))
    81	  rw [show (((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict hoverlap (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x)) :
    82	      Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)ˣ) : Γ(relCurve C B, (W ⊓ W').opens x)) =
    83	        (relCurve C B).resHom hoverlap
    84	          (D.unit (σ x) (σ' x) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (σ x) ⊓ D.pieces (σ' x)))
    85	      from rfl, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component]
    86	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key ⊢
    87	  exact key
    88	
    89	/-! ## Coefficient-change naturality -/
    90	
    91	/-- Restricting the datum-piece comparison to the actual preimage piece gives the
    92	arbitrary-affine section comparison.  This is the pointwise equation bridge between the
    93	base-changed glued section and `LocalEquations.pullbackEqn`. -/
    94	theorem resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap
    95	    [IsAffineHom pi]
    96	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    97	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    98	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (j : D.index)
    99	    (t : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)) :
   100	    (relCurve C B').resHom
   101	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' j).ge
   102	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j t) =
   103	      relAffSectionsMap C B' (D.pieces j) t := by
   104	  cases j with
   105	  | inl j =>
   106	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
   107	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inl,
   108	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
   109	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   110	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
   111	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inl j))
   112	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤
   113	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
   114	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inl j)).ge t)
   115	  | inr j =>
   116	      simpa only [BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap, pieceSectionsMap,
   117	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange, Sum.elim_inr,
   118	        relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom_refl] using
   119	        ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   120	          (le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   121	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inr j))
   122	          (le_rfl : relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤
   123	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   124	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B' (Sum.inr j)).ge t)
   125	
   126	/-- The equation obtained by pulling back the canonical section-cut local equations is the
   127	arbitrary-affine comparison of the selected datum component. -/
   128	theorem pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap
   129	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   130	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   131	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   132	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   133	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   134	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   135	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (z : relCurve C B') :
   136	    Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
   137	        (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) z =
   138	      relAffSectionsMap C B'
   139	        (D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z)))
   140	        (D.component s (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base z))) := by
   141	  simp [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn,
   142	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
   143	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations,
   144	    relAffSectionsMap, Scheme.resHom]
   145	
   146	/-- Pulling back the divisor cut by a fibrewise-regular glued section is `DivEq` to the
   147	divisor cut by the compared section on the canonical cover after an arbitrary affine
   148	coefficient change.  The first comparison has unit `1` on the pulled cover; the second is
   149	the transition-unit refinement supplied by `sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section`. -/
   150	theorem pullback_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_divEq_sectionsMapTop
   151	    [IsFinite pi] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   152	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   153	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   154	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   155	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   156	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   157	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] [IsNoetherianRing B']
   158	    (hfib' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B'),
   159	      Function.Injective
   160	        ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B'
   161	          ((D.baseChange B').component (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j)).rTensor
   162	            p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   163	    (hpull : ∀ (y z : relCurve C B')
   164	      (hz : z ∈ ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
   165	        (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y),
   166	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ
   167	        (((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).cover.pullback
   168	          (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y) z hz).hom
   169	          (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C B B')
   170	            (D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib) y) ∈
   171	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z)) :
   172	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
   173	      ((D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s hfib).pullback
   174	        (relCurveMap C B B') hpull)
   175	      ((D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   176	        (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) hfib') := by
   177	  let f := relCurveMap C B B'
   178	  let W := D.pointedCover.pullback f
   179	  let sigma : relCurve C B' → D.index := fun z => D.pieceIndex (f.base z)
   180	  let hsigma : ∀ z : relCurve C B', W.opens z ≤ (D.baseChange B').pieces (sigma z) :=
   181	    fun z => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' z
   182	  let s' := D.sectionsMapTop B' s
   183	  let hreg' : ∀ (j : (D.baseChange B').index) (z : relCurve C B')
   184	      (hz : z ∈ (D.baseChange B').pieces j),
   185	      ((relCurve C B').presheaf.germ ((D.baseChange B').pieces j) z hz).hom
   186	          ((D.baseChange B').component s' j) ∈
   187	        nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B').presheaf.stalk z) :=
   188	    fun j z hz =>
   189	      (D.baseChange B').germ_component_mem_nonZeroDivisors s' j (hfib' j) z hz
   190	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq.trans (d₂ :=
   191	    (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations s' W sigma hsigma hreg') ?_ ?_
   192	  · refine ⟨W, (fun _ => le_rfl), (fun _ => le_rfl), fun z => ?_⟩
   193	    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   194	    rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
   195	    simp only [Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback_eqn, sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
   196	    rw [D.pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquations_eq_relAffSectionsMap s hfib B' z]
   197	    rw [D.component_sectionsMapTop B' s (sigma z)]
   198	    apply congrArg ((relCurve C B').resHom _)
   199	    exact (D.resHom_piecesMap_eq_relAffSectionsMap B' (sigma z)
   200	      (D.component s (sigma z))).symm
   201	  · simpa only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular,
   202	      s', hreg'] using
   203	      (D.baseChange B').sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section s'
   204	        W (D.baseChange B').pointedCover sigma (D.baseChange B').pieceIndex
   205	        hsigma (fun _ => le_rfl) hreg'
   206	
   207	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

   209	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite gluing of the rank-one evaluation divisor on a presentation carrier
    12	
    13	Over the Noetherian affine carrier of a tied rank-one presentation, the local evaluation
    14	divisors produced on a finite spanning family of principal opens are compatible on pairwise
    15	overlaps.  They therefore glue to an actual `DivFamZarAff` on the carrier.  Zariski separation
    16	of `PicEtAff` identifies the Abel value of the glue with the represented input class, and
    17	injectivity of the etale-plus unit identifies its relative Picard class with the presentation
    18	representative.  The chosen local sections retain their exact Cech-class and native evaluation
    19	identities.
    20	
    21	This is deliberately only a Noetherian, presentation-carrier result.  It does **not** descend
    22	the glued divisor through the etale cover to the original algebra `A`, does not prove
    23	independence of the chosen presentation, does not construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback
    24	square, and does not produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    29	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    34	open scoped TensorProduct
    35	
    36	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    46	
    47	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    48	
    49	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    50	/-- The finite principal-open evaluation divisors of a tied rank-one presentation glue on its
    51	Noetherian etale carrier.  The result records the global Abel and relative-Picard identities,
    52	while retaining the exact local Cech-class and evaluation identities of the chosen sections.
    53	
    54	The divisor `F0` lives over `P.cover.Carrier`; this theorem neither descends it to `A` nor
    55	constructs `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`. -/
    56	theorem exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    57	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    58	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
    59	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → P.cover.Carrier)
    60	      (y : Fin m → Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    61	      (hy : ∀ (i : Fin m) (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier),
    62	        f i ∉ q.asIdeal →
    63	          (y i ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    64	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    65	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    66	      (F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)),
    67	      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
    68	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    69	          DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    70	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    71	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0 =
    72	            P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)) ∧
    73	        abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
    74	          PicEtAff.mapAlg C
    75	            ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    76	            (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) ∧
    77	        relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
    78	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) ∧
    79	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    80	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    81	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    82	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0).picClass =
    83	            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass) ∧
    84	        ∀ i : Fin m,
    85	          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hgood⟩ :=
    91	    P.exists_fin_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    92	  choose y hy habel hclass heval using hgood
    93	  let F : ∀ i : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f i)) (genus C) :=
    94	    fun i => P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)
    95	  have hcompat : ∀ i j : Fin m,
    96	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f i j) (F i) =
    97	        DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f i j) (F j) := by
    98	    intro i j
    99	    exact P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat
   100	      (f i) (f j) (y i) (y j) (hy i) (hy j)
   101	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ :=
   102	    DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
   103	  have habel0 : abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
   104	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   105	        ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   106	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   107	    refine PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq C
   108	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
   109	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down)) ?_ (fun l => ?_)
   110	    · rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
   111	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   112	      exact hspan
   113	    · let i := l.down
   114	      change PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   115	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   116	            (Localization.Away (f i)))
   117	          (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) = _
   118	      calc
   119	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   120	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   121	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   122	            (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) =
   123	            abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))
   124	              (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   125	                (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   126	                  (Localization.Away (f i))) F0) :=
   127	          abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom
   128	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   129	              (Localization.Away (f i))) F0
   130	        _ = abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i)) (F i) :=
   131	          congrArg (abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))) (hF0 i)
   132	        _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   133	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   134	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   135	            (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   136	              ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   137	              (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   138	          have hphi :
   139	              (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))).restrictScalars k =
   140	                IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i)) :=
   141	            AlgHom.ext (fun _ => rfl)
   142	          rw [← hphi]
   143	          simpa only [F] using habel i
   144	  have htarget :
   145	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   146	          ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   147	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) =
   148	        PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   149	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   150	    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   151	  have hrel : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
   152	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   153	    apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C P.cover.Carrier
   154	    rw [← htarget]
   155	    exact habel0
   156	  refine ⟨m, f, y, hy, F0, hspan, ?_, habel0, hrel, ?_, heval⟩
   157	  · intro i
   158	    simpa only [F] using hF0 i
   159	  · intro i
   160	    rw [hF0 i]
   161	    exact hclass i
   162	
   163	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   164	
   165	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!

    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	
    23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
    24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29

    46	
    47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=

    51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    53	
    54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/

    59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/

    64	
    65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
    68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    69	
    70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    71	
    72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    73	
    74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
    79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
    80	
    81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
    82	
    83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
    84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
    87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
    88	
    89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
    90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
    92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
    93	
    94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
    95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
    96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
    97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
    98	
    99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
   100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
   101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
   102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
   103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
   104	  inv := E.divisor
   105	  hom_inv_id := h
   106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
   107	
   108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   109	
   110	/--
   111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
   112	
   113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
   114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
   115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
   116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
   117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
   118	
   119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
   120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
   121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
   122	-/
   123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
   127	  W : X.Opens
   128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   129	  restrictedValue_eq :
   130	    restrictedValue =
   131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
   132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
   133	  nativePresentation :
   134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
   136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
   138	
   139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   140	
   141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   144	
   145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   147	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   151	
   152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   156	
   157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   162	
   163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   165	def FibreFactorizationClause
   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   169	      g.app (op S) w →
   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172	
   173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
   177	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
   178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   180	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   181	
   182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   189	
   190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   213	  have hcompat :
   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]
   224	    exact hvw
   225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
   238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app S v
   239	
   240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl
   261	
   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g
   281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback (hpb X g)
   282	
   283	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   284	
   285	end
   286	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite gluing of the rank-one evaluation divisor on a presentation carrier
    12	
    13	Over the Noetherian affine carrier of a tied rank-one presentation, the local evaluation
    14	divisors produced on a finite spanning family of principal opens are compatible on pairwise
    15	overlaps.  They therefore glue to an actual `DivFamZarAff` on the carrier.  Zariski separation
    16	of `PicEtAff` identifies the Abel value of the glue with the represented input class, and
    17	injectivity of the etale-plus unit identifies its relative Picard class with the presentation
    18	representative.  The chosen local sections retain their exact Cech-class and native evaluation
    19	identities.
    20	
    21	This is deliberately only a Noetherian, presentation-carrier result.  It does **not** descend
    22	the glued divisor through the etale cover to the original algebra `A`, does not prove
    23	independence of the chosen presentation, does not construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback
    24	square, and does not produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    29	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    30	
    31	universe u

    34	open scoped TensorProduct

    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    46	
    47	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    48	
    49	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    50	/-- The finite principal-open evaluation divisors of a tied rank-one presentation glue on its
    51	Noetherian etale carrier.  The result records the global Abel and relative-Picard identities,
    52	while retaining the exact local Cech-class and evaluation identities of the chosen sections.
    53	
    54	The divisor `F0` lives over `P.cover.Carrier`; this theorem neither descends it to `A` nor
    55	constructs `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`. -/
    56	theorem exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    57	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    58	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
    59	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → P.cover.Carrier)
    60	      (y : Fin m → Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    61	      (hy : ∀ (i : Fin m) (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier),
    62	        f i ∉ q.asIdeal →
    63	          (y i ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    64	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    65	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    66	      (F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)),
    67	      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
    68	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    69	          DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    70	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    71	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0 =
    72	            P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)) ∧
    73	        abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
    74	          PicEtAff.mapAlg C
    75	            ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    76	            (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) ∧
    77	        relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
    78	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) ∧
    79	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    80	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    81	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    82	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0).picClass =
    83	            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass) ∧
    84	        ∀ i : Fin m,
    85	          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hgood⟩ :=
    91	    P.exists_fin_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    92	  choose y hy habel hclass heval using hgood
    93	  let F : ∀ i : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f i)) (genus C) :=
    94	    fun i => P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)
    95	  have hcompat : ∀ i j : Fin m,
    96	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f i j) (F i) =
    97	        DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f i j) (F j) := by
    98	    intro i j
    99	    exact P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat
   100	      (f i) (f j) (y i) (y j) (hy i) (hy j)
   101	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ :=
   102	    DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
   103	  have habel0 : abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
   104	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   105	        ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   106	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   107	    refine PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq C
   108	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
   109	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down)) ?_ (fun l => ?_)
   110	    · rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
   111	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   112	      exact hspan
   113	    · let i := l.down
   114	      change PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   115	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   116	            (Localization.Away (f i)))
   117	          (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) = _
   118	      calc
   119	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   120	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   121	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   122	            (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) =
   123	            abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))
   124	              (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   125	                (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   126	                  (Localization.Away (f i))) F0) :=
   127	          abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom
   128	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   129	              (Localization.Away (f i))) F0
   130	        _ = abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i)) (F i) :=
   131	          congrArg (abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))) (hF0 i)
   132	        _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   133	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   134	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   135	            (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   136	              ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   137	              (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   138	          have hphi :
   139	              (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))).restrictScalars k =
   140	                IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i)) :=
   141	            AlgHom.ext (fun _ => rfl)
   142	          rw [← hphi]
   143	          simpa only [F] using habel i
   144	  have htarget :
   145	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   146	          ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   147	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) =
   148	        PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   149	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   150	    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   151	  have hrel : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
   152	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   153	    apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C P.cover.Carrier
   154	    rw [← htarget]
   155	    exact habel0
   156	  refine ⟨m, f, y, hy, F0, hspan, ?_, habel0, hrel, ?_, heval⟩
   157	  · intro i
   158	    simpa only [F] using hF0 i
   159	  · intro i
   160	    rw [hF0 i]
   161	    exact hclass i
   162

    86	-- The dependent fibrewise-regularity and local-equation cast comparison is expensive to elaborate.
    87	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mapAlgHom_mul_left
    88	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    89	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    90	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    91	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    92	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    93	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    94	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]

    98	        (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
    99	      P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y

   102	  let B' := Localization.Away (f * g)
   103	  let phi : B →ₐ[k] B' :=
   104	    DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd (k := k) (f * g) f g rfl
   105	  letI algBB' : Algebra B B' := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
   106	  letI smulBB' : SMul B B' := algBB'.toSMul
   107	  haveI towPB : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier B B' :=
   108	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
   109	      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl

    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :

   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/

   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor

   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w

   388	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
   389	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   390	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   391	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module),

    40	/--
    41	The part of a native presentation forced by the displayed Picard value.
    42	
    43	`represents` ties the etale-plus representative to `lam`, while `datum_class` ties the
    44	basic-open cocycle datum to that same representative. The geometric certificates that enrich
    45	this datum are intentionally absent.

    47	structure PicRankOneNativeDatum
    48	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    49	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    50	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    51	  represents :
    52	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    53	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    54	  datum_class :
    55	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    56	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass

    60	/-- Every displayed affine Picard value has a tied basic-open cocycle datum.
    61	
    62	The proof exposes an etale-plus representative of the displayed value, chooses a Cech
    63	representative of its relative Picard class, and refines that class to a basic-open datum.
    64	-/
    65	theorem nonempty
    66	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    67	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) :
    68	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam) := by
    69	  have hplus : ∀ a : PicEtAff C A,
    70	      ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E),
    71	        PicEtAff.mk C E x = a := by
    72	    intro a
    73	    induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
    74	    | mk E x => exact ⟨E, x, rfl⟩
    75	  obtain ⟨E, x, hrep⟩ := hplus (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    76	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := relPicMk_surjective C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
    77	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))
    78	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq
    79	    (C := C) (B := E.Carrier) (π := pi) c
    80	  refine ⟨
    81	    { cover := E
    82	      representative := x
    83	      represents := hrep
    84	      datum := D
    85	      datum_class := ?_ }⟩
    86	  calc
    87	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
    88	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) c := hc.symm
    89	    _ = relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass :=
    90	      congrArg (relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) hD.symm

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
    93	
    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property
   140	
   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl
   166	
   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl

   253	/-- A named carrier choice for consumers which already possess the Picard openness theorem. -/
   254	def divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen
   255	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : DivRankOneOpenData pi :=
   256	  Classical.choice (divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen pi h)
   257	
   258	/-- The open subscheme supplied by a `DivRankOneOpenData` witness. -/
   259	def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
   260	  h.carrier.toScheme
   261	
   262	/-- The canonical open immersion into the genus divisor representer. -/
   263	def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   264	    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   265	  h.carrier.ι
   266	
   267	theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   269	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h) := by
   270	  change IsOpenImmersion h.carrier.ι
   271	  infer_instance
   272	
   273	/- The scheme-level certificate also has the presheaf form consumed by relative-open inverse
   274	   constructions.  This is conditional only on the explicit carrier witness above. -/
   275	theorem divRankOneOpenMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   276	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   277	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)) := by
   278	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion pi h)
   279	
   280	/-- The open represented object, retained in the slice over `Spec k` for consumers of the affine
   281	divisor functor. -/
   282	def divRankOneOpenOver (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   283	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   284	  Over.mk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   285	
   286	/-- The inclusion of the certified open, as a morphism in the slice over `Spec k`.
   287	
   288	This is the map whose Yoneda action is consumed by the canonical rank-one Abel inverse.  Naming
   289	it separately keeps consumers independent of the implementation spelling of `divRankOneOpenOver`.
   290	-/
   291	def divRankOneOpenOverMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   292	    divRankOneOpenOver pi h ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   293	  Over.homMk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)
   294	
   295	/-- Pull back the certified rank-one open along an arbitrary slice morphism. -/
   296	def divRankOneOpenPullback
   297	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   298	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) : T.left.Opens :=
   299	  q.left ⁻¹ᵁ h.carrier
   300	
   301	theorem divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion
   302	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   303	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   304	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι := by
   305	  infer_instance
   306	
   307	/-- The arbitrary slice pullback remains an open immersion after passing to Yoneda. -/
   308	theorem divRankOneOpenPullbackMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   309	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   310	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   311	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   312	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι) := by
   313	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion pi h q)
   314	
   315	/-- Pointwise form of arbitrary base-change compatibility for the certified open. -/
   316	theorem mem_divRankOneOpenPullback_iff
   317	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   318	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)
   319	    (x : T.left) :
   320	    x ∈ divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q ↔ q.left.base x ∈ h.carrier := by
   321	  rfl
   322	
   323	/-- The universal predicate is exactly the represented preimage used by the Abel restriction. -/
   324	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage :
   325	    divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi = divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi :=
   326	  rfl
   327	
   328	/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
   329	theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
   330	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   331	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
   332	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
   333	  h.carrier_eq
   334	
   335	/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.
   336	
   337	The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
   338	replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
   339	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
   340	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   341	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   342	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   343	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   344	      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
   345	  rw [h.carrier_eq]
   346	
   347	/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.
   348	
   349	Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
   350	of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
   351	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
   352	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   353	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   354	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   355	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   356	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
   357	          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
   358	        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
   359	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]

   152	            (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   153	              PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op).hom x } := by

   170	    change (snd C (overSpec k B)).left.base ⁻¹'

    12	/-!
    13	# Native presentations for split field classes
    14	
    15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
    16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
    17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
    18	
    19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
    20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
    21	
    22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
    23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
    24	-/

    45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
    46	
    47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
    48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
    49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
    50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
    51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
    52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
    53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
    54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
    55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
    56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
    57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
    58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    59	    apply Spec.map_injective
    60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
    61	    exact hw
    62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
    63	    { __ := psi.hom
    64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
    65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
    66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    67	  ext : 1

   100	/-- Comparing glued sections in two stages agrees with direct comparison after transport by the
   101	canonical equality of the two base-changed cocycle data. -/
   102	theorem sectionsMap_tower (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
   103	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   104	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
   105	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} {W' : (relCurve C R').Opens}
   106	    {W'' : (relCurve C R'').Opens}
   107	    (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
   108	    (hW'' : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R' R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W')
   109	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule R D.pieces D.unit W)) :
   110	    let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   111	      D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   112	    let hcomp : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
   113	      rw [← relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R''),
   114	        Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   115	      exact hW''.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hW')
   116	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
   117	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit W'')) hD)
   118	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMap R'' hW'' (D.sectionsMap R' hW' s)) =
   119	      D.sectionsMap R'' hcomp s := by
   120	  let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   121	    D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   122	  let hcomp : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
   123	    rw [← relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R''),
   124	      Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
   125	    exact hW''.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hW')
   126	  change cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
   127	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit W'')) hD)
   128	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMap R'' hW'' (D.sectionsMap R' hW' s)) =
   129	      D.sectionsMap R'' hcomp s
   130	  apply cast_gluedSubmodule_eq_of_val_heq C hD
   131	  apply Function.hfunext rfl
   132	  intro j j' hj
   133	  cases hj
   134	  let hopen : W'' ⊓ ((D.baseChange R').baseChange R'').pieces j =
   135	      W'' ⊓ (D.baseChange R'').pieces j :=
   136	    congrArg (fun V : (relCurve C R'').Opens => W'' ⊓ V)
   137	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_tower C R R' R'' j)
   138	  apply (Equiv.cast_eq_iff_heq
   139	    (congrArg (fun V : (relCurve C R'').Opens => ↑(Γ(relCurve C R'', V))) hopen)).mp
   140	  simp only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMap_coe]
   141	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
   142	  exact cast_appLE_congr
   143	    (relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R'')) hopen _ _ (s.val j)
   144	
   145	/-- Global glued-section comparison is transitive along an arbitrary coefficient tower. -/
   146	theorem sectionsMapTop_tower (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
   147	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   148	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
   149	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule R D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) :
   150	    let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   151	      D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   152	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
   153	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
   154	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMapTop R'' (D.sectionsMapTop R' s)) =
   155	      D.sectionsMapTop R'' s := by
   156	  let hW' : (⊤ : (relCurve C R').Opens) ≤
   157	      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) := by
   158	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]

   160	      relCurveMap C R' R'' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C R').Opens) := by
   161	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]

   163	    sectionsMap_tower C R R' D R'' hW' hW'' s

    36	/-!
    37	# Native pullback comparison
    38	
    39	The datum-level `sectionsMap` is already linear over the structure-sheaf map and
    40	commutes with restriction.  It therefore gives a morphism from the native module
    41	to the pushforward of the base-changed native module.  Its adjoint is the
    42	canonical comparison from the geometric pullback of `D.nativeModule` to the
    43	native module rebuilt from `D.baseChange B'`.
    44	-/
    45	
    46	/-- `sectionsMap`, assembled as an `O_{C_B}`-linear map into pushforward. -/
    47	noncomputable def nativeModuleSectionsMap :
    48	    D.nativeModule ⟶
    49	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (relCurveMap C B B')).obj
    50	        (D.baseChange B').nativeModule :=
    51	  ⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk
    52	    { app := fun U ↦ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
    53	        (fun s ↦ D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    54	        (fun s t ↦ D.sectionsMap_add B' le_rfl s t)
    55	      naturality := fun {U V} i ↦ by
    56	        ext s
    57	        change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    58	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit i.unop.le s) =
    59	          gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
    60	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le)
    61	            (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    62	        exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B' i.unop.le le_rfl le_rfl
    63	          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le) s).symm }
    64	    (fun U r s ↦ by
    65	      change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    66	          (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit le_rfl r s) =
    67	        gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit le_rfl
    68	          (((relCurveMap C B B').app U.unop).hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    69	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using
    70	        D.sectionsMap_gluedQsmul B'
    71	          (W := U.unop) (W' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    72	          (V := U.unop) (V' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    73	          le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl r s)⟩

    79	  rfl

    82	pullback of the original native module.  This is adjoint to `sectionsMap` on
