   119	private theorem unit_hom_ext_top {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules}
   120	    (f g : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M)
   121	    (h : f.val.app (.op (⊤ : X.Opens)) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) =
   122	      g.val.app (.op (⊤ : X.Opens)) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) : f = g := by
   123	  apply (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget X.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
   124	  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
   125	  intro U
   126	  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   127	  apply LinearMap.ext
   128	  intro x
   129	  change Γ(X, U.unop) at x
   130	  change f.val.app U x = g.val.app U x
   131	  rw [show x = x • (1 : Γ(X, U.unop)) by simp, map_smul, map_smul]
   132	  congr 1
   133	  have hf := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))
   134	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf f).naturality
   135	      (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op)
   136	  have hg := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))
   137	    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.mapPresheaf g).naturality
   138	      (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op)
   139	  change f.val.app U ((X.presheaf.map
   140	      (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op).hom 1) =
   141	    (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op).hom
   142	      (f.val.app (.op (⊤ : X.Opens)) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) at hf
   143	  change g.val.app U ((X.presheaf.map
   144	      (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op).hom 1) =
   145	    (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op).hom
   146	      (g.val.app (.op (⊤ : X.Opens)) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) at hg
   147	  rw [map_one] at hf hg
   148	  exact hf.trans ((congrArg
   149	    (fun z ↦ (M.presheaf.map
   150	      (homOfLE (le_top : U.unop ≤ (⊤ : X.Opens))).op).hom z) h).trans hg.symm)

   165	private theorem pullbackRestrictIso_baseMap_top
   166	    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens)
   167	    (N : X.Modules) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
   168	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
   169	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictIso g U).hom.app N)
   170	        (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens)).hom
   171	      (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g N
   172	        (show (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U by simp) x) =
   173	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap (g ∣_ U)
   174	        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
   175	        (le_top : (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ≤
   176	          (g ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
   177	        ((N.presheaf.map
   178	          (eqToHom (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top U)).op).hom x) := by
   179	  let f := (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
   180	  have eRange : f.opensRange ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U :=
   181	    le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))
   182	  have eImage : f ''ᵁ (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
   183	    simp [f]
   184	  have ePreRange : (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ f.opensRange :=
   185	    le_of_eq (Scheme.Hom.preimage_opensRange f).symm
   186	  have eCompSource : (⊤ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) ≤ (f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
   187	    rw [← morphismRestrict_ι g U]

     6	
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativeBaseChangeCartesian
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Canonicalize an existing rank-one presentation
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` is the public producer contract, but its `module` field is an
    13	auxiliary presentation of the cocycle sheaf.  The native rank-one consumer needs the canonical
    14	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.nativeModule` instead.  This file supplies the honest bridge: it keeps the
    15	same cover, representative, and cocycle datum, copies the cohomology/rank certificates, and
    16	derives native pushforward base change from the actual datum's vanishing theorem.  No new witness
    17	or unrelated module is introduced.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    26	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    31	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    39	
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    42	
    43	/-- Replace the auxiliary module in a local presentation by the datum's canonical native module.
    44	
    45	The native pushforward comparison is obtained from the same datum and its `H¹` certificate, so
    46	the resulting structure remains tied to the original lambda value and does not assume a new
    47	base-change theorem.
    48	-/
    49	noncomputable def ofLocalPresentation
    50	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    51	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    52	  { cover := P.cover
    53	    representative := P.representative
    54	    represents := P.represents
    55	    datum := P.datum
    56	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    57	    native_pushforward_base_change := fun g f' g' sq =>
    58	      P.datum.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule
    59	        ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
    60	        g f' g' sq
    61	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
    62	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
    63	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
    64	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
    65	
    66	/-- A local presentation always yields a nonempty canonical native presentation. -/
    67	theorem nonempty_of_localPresentation
    68	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    69	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :=
    70	  ⟨ofLocalPresentation pi P⟩
    71	
    72	/-- Convert the complete affine-pullback producer contract to its native form.
    73	
    74	The conversion is pointwise but preserves the exact pulled-back lambda and the actual datum at
    75	each test algebra; it is therefore suitable for a later native `FibrePresented` consumer.
    76	-/
    77	theorem nonempty_of_localPresentations
    78	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    80	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    81	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    82	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    83	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    84	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    85	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    86	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
    87	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    88	  intro A _ _ t
    89	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
    90	  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_localPresentation pi P
    91	
    92	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
    93	
    94	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RankOneFamilyCertificatesDescent
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Lambda-tied assembly of rank-one family certificates
    12	
    13	This file is the Picard-side consumer of `RankOneFamilyCertificates`.  It does not choose a
    14	module: the certificate and the native presentation are both attached to the displayed cocycle
    15	datum.  The cover representative and its equality with the displayed lambda class provide the
    16	Picard tie, while arbitrary-cartesian native pushforward base change remains a separate geometric
    17	input.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    26	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    31	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    40	
    41	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    42	
    43	/-! ## The literal native consumer -/
    44	
    45	/-- Assemble the native presentation from certificates for the same displayed cocycle datum.
    46	
    47	The equalities `hrep` and `hclass` tie the datum to the requested lambda class.  All four
    48	cohomological fields are projected from `cert`, whose modules are definitionally the H-modules
    49	of `D.sheaf`; no unrelated or pre-certified target module can enter.  The all-cartesian native
    50	pushforward comparison is intentionally an explicit argument until its protected producer lands.
    51	-/
    52	noncomputable def ofCertificates
    53	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    54	    (x : descentClasses C E)
    55	    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    56	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    57	    (hclass :
    58	      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
    59	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
    60	    (hpush :
    61	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    62	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    63	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C E.Carrier)
    64	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    65	          (relCurve C E.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) g),
    66	        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app D.nativeModule))
    67	    (cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D) :
    68	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    69	  { cover := E
    70	    representative := x
    71	    represents := hrep
    72	    datum := D
    73	    datum_class := hclass
    74	    native_pushforward_base_change := hpush
    75	    h1_vanishing := cert.h1_vanishing
    76	    h0_finite := cert.h0_finite
    77	    h0_projective := cert.h0_projective
    78	    h0_rank_one := cert.h0_rank_one }
    79	
    80	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
    81	
    82	end AlgebraicGeometry
